notes.title: Minor update: 1.02
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Ive just released some fixes for some issues that have been brought to my attention since release, they are minor issues but help make things look how they are supposed to. My focus at the moment has been working on a trailer for the game whilst I brainstorm ways of fixing my SFX issue, but I'll be working on that for the next update so please bare with me. A list of the changes are below.


 Fixed the sword that was active in the throne room
 Fixed Miranda's positioning when returning to the village as Kenneth
 Fixed an issue in the chapel where the coffin couldn't be interacted with
 Fixed the overlapping sprites on Kenneth in the forest cutscene
 Added walls to the back of the safari so it isn't just an endless void in view



I believe those were all the changes I made. As I said, they were very minor visual things, nothing super exciting.

I hope you're all enjoying the game

notes.title: Update Notes for version 1.01
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, just made a quick update, finally was able to fix the last biggest issue i had ill leave a list of changes below


 Fixed returning to main menu audio bug, the audio will be just fine when you return to the game now.

 Added 2 audio clips that I somehow missed

 I made it so the big painting in the endings room is no longer there; you weren't supposed to see that yet...

 Fixed some colliders

 Made areas in the village off-limits unless they are supposed to be accessed based on your first couple of choices

 Removed load game text from start screen, the load game button now works based on if you have a save file or not, it wasn't working properly at release unfortunately 



I think that was everything, I hope you're all enjoying the game and let me know if you have any problems or queries

notes.title: Slight release delay
notes.notes:
Heyyy, so as much as I hate doing this, I'm going to be pushing back the release date back 1 week to the 8th of April. We were on track for release, however, I have encountered some game breaking bugs that I haven't been able to fix as of yet, if they were small things I wouldn't worry so much and I would fix them post release. However, they do cut off some sections and access to content in the game. It doesn't feel fair on any of you if I presented a game like that to you.

However since I now have all the content in the game, my only focus is to fix those bugs, and 1 week should be plenty of time (hopefully).
